title: Hit feel · Hit-stop, fringing and camera punch
description: How a blow lands in a fight (src/hit-feel.ts, docs/graphics.md): the fight holds still for a few frames on contact, the picture lurches along the blow and springs back, and heavy moments fringe the colours apart, swell the bloom and punch the frame in. Time is frozen and stepped 1/60 s at a time so each shot is a known moment around contact; the log at the bottom left times every contact, hold and resolution.

steps.caption: The fight at rest, time frozen: the scenario steps it 1/60 s at a time from here and logs each action (bottom left)
Contact: the fight holds on this pose (the dog squashed and white), the picture lurches along the blow

steps.eval: hf.step(3).then(() => hf.probe("attack, 50 ms into the hold"))

steps.caption: 50 ms later: still the same pose, only the camera springs back and the sparks drift on, slowed
After the hold: the dog recoils and the fight goes on
A dog bites Gerard: a plain blow, held a few frames, no fringe
Bernat guards: a short hold and a small lurch
Q / L swaps the ánima: a light swell of bloom and a touch of fringe
No-ta on a dog with 1 PV left: the stamp falling
The stamp slams and knocks the dog out: the longest hold, full fringe, bloom swell, the frame punches in and the picture slams down

steps.eval: hf.step(5).then(() => hf.probe("No-ta, 83 ms into the hold"))

steps.caption: 83 ms in: still held; fringe and bloom fading, the punch springing back
After: the dog tips over and the camera shakes out
An ánima wakes (called directly here): full fringe and bloom, a punch-in and a shake

steps.eval: hf.step(30).then(() => { const g = window.gerard.game; g.post.enabled = false; g.post.pulse(1, 1); hf.say(`post off: pulse ignored, fringing ${g.post.frame.fringing.intensity.toFixed(2)}`); g.post.enabled = true; hf.summary(); })

steps.caption: The timing log: contact on time, the hold, and every action resolving 1167 ms plus its hold
prefers-reduced-motion: the attack resolves at once, with no hold, lurch or fringe
